protocol.ablation: All synaptic weights set to zero; input injection preserved.
protocol.indexMeaning: Worker group-sorted index, valid only for the hashed connectome and worker. Not a FlyWire root_id.
protocol.candidateCriterion: Any downstream spike or post-update potential >= 0.1. Deterministic model; these are not biological replications.
protocol.vibration: Constant injection in this mapping run; pulsed in sweep.cjs.
